newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 125 mln stg further help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 125 mln stg further help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 125 million stg of assistance at established interest rates after revising its forecast money market shortage to 1.3 billion stg.
The Bank allotted 72 million stg outright in bills maturing on or before June 12 and 53 million in repos to June 11 and 12.
It has now provided liquidity totalling 1.175 billion stg so far on Thursday.
